set.label: At risk per $1B spent on projects
set.source: PMI, Pulse of the Profession 2013 — money put at risk by poor project performance

edits.claim: fallback stat: $135M lost per $1B, unrecoverable loss
edits.src: PMI Pulse of the Profession 2013: "US$135 million is at risk for every US$1 billion spent on a project" (at risk, not lost)

set.label: More projects meet original goals
set.source: PMI, Pulse of the Profession 2017 — organizations whose enterprise PMO is aligned to strategy

edits.claim: fallback stat: 38% more projects on time/budget with a PMO vs without
edits.src: PMI Pulse of the Profession 2017 "Success Rates Rise": organizations aligning their EPMO to strategy report 38% more projects meeting original goals and business intent (not PMO vs none, on time/budget)

set.source: PMI, Pulse of the Profession 2020 — organizations that undervalue project management as a strategic competency

edits.claim: fallback stat: 67% more projects fail outright (undated)
edits.src: PMI Pulse of the Profession 2020 "Ahead of the Curve": 67% more projects failing outright where PM is undervalued as a strategic competency
